findings.title: Microsoft Exchange Server CVE-2026-42897 added to CISA KEV — still no permanent patch, 21-day federal deadline 2026-06-06
findings.summary: CISA formally added Microsoft Exchange CVE-2026-42897 OWA XSS-via-crafted-email to KEV on 2026-05-16 with a 2026-06-06 federal deadline; Microsoft has still shipped only configuration-level mitigations, no permanent code patch, mirroring the operationally-painful ProxyNotShell / ProxyShell pattern.

findings.title: Microsoft Azure Backup for AKS — Confused Deputy (Backup Contributor → cluster-admin); Microsoft refused CVE, silently patched (CERT/CC VU#284781)
findings.affected_technology: Azure Backup for AKS (Azure Kubernetes Service)
findings.summary: Backup-Contributor-to-cluster-admin confused-deputy escalation via auto-established AKS Trusted Access; Microsoft refused CVE and silently patched, leaving defenders without a CVE-anchored audit trail (CERT/CC VU#284781).
